Part 1 高频 事件 EVENTS

Shopping

购物

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1Do you like shopping?

To be honest, not really. I only go shopping when my girlfriend drags me along, and even then, I'd rather finish quickly and head home. It's just not something I get excited about, really.

说实话不太喜欢，一般只陪女朋友去，想快点买完回家。

Q2How often do you go shopping?

Not very often, honestly, maybe a couple of times a month at most. Usually it's with my girlfriend, when she needs to buy clothes or things for the house. I don't go browsing on my own, that's for sure.

不太频繁，一个月最多一两次，基本是陪女朋友买衣服或日用品。

Q3Do you prefer online shopping or in-store shopping?

Definitely online shopping. It's so much more convenient, I can order anything without leaving the house, and it arrives in a couple of days. Honestly, not having to go out is the biggest selling point for me.

绝对喜欢网购，方便、不用出门，两三天就能送到。

Q4Have you ever returned anything you bought online?

Yeah, I have, a few times. Once I ordered a pair of shoes a size too small, so I sent them back and got a refund. The whole process took about a week, which wasn't too bad.

退过几次，比如鞋码太小就寄回去退款了，流程一周左右。
